import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'date': ['2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01'],
    'time': ['00:00', '02:00', '04:00', '06:00', '08:00'],
    'product': ['Cappuccino', 'Cappuccino', 'Tea', 'Latte', 'Americano'],
    'size': ['Large', 'Medium', 'Small', 'Large', 'Medium'],
    'price': [4.18, 4.01, 5.22, 6.37, 7.07],
    'quantity': [2, 3, 1, 2, 3],
    'payment_method': ['Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Cash'],
    'customer_age_group': ['55+', '35-44', '18-24', '45-54', '45-54'],
    'is_takeaway': [1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
    'total': [8.36, 12.03, 5.22, 12.74, 21.21]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create datetime column for time series analysis
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Define color palette
palette = sns.color_palette("husl", len(df['product'].unique()))

# 1. Sales by product and size (bar plot)
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
product_size_data = df.groupby(['product', 'size']).agg({'total': 'sum', 'quantity': 'sum'}).reset_index()
product_size_pivot = product_size_data.pivot(index='product', columns='size', values='total').fillna(0)
product_size_pivot.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1'])
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product and Size', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax1.legend(title='Size')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Sales trend over time (line plot)
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
df_sorted = df.sort_values('datetime')
ax2.plot(df_sorted['datetime'], df_sorted['total'], marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#95E1D3')
ax2.fill_between(df_sorted['datetime'], df_sorted['total'], alpha=0.3, color='#95E1D3')
ax2.set_title('Sales Trend Throughout the Day', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Time')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sale Amount ($)')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Payment method distribution (pie chart)
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
payment_data = df.groupby('payment_method')['total'].sum()
colors_pie = ['#FFD166', '#06D6A0']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(payment_data.values, labels=payment_data.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                   colors=colors_pie, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Sales Distribution by Payment Method', fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 4. Customer age group analysis (bar plot)
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
age_group_data = df.groupby('customer_age_group').agg({'total': 'sum', 'quantity': 'sum'}).reset_index()
age_group_data = age_group_data.sort_values('total', ascending=False)
bars = ax4.bar(age_group_data['customer_age_group'], age_group_data['total'], color='#118AB2')
ax4.set_title('Sales by Customer Age Group', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Age Group')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.5,
             f'${height:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 5. Quantity vs Price scatter plot
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
scatter = ax5.scatter(df['price'], df['quantity'], s=df['total']*20, c=range(len(df)),
                      cmap='viridis', alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax5.set_title('Price vs Quantity (Bubble Size = Total Sale)', fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Price per Item ($)')
ax5.set_ylabel('Quantity Sold')
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    ax5.annotate(row['product'], (row['price'], row['quantity']),
                 xytext=(5, 5), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=8)

# 6. Summary statistics table
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
ax6.axis('tight')
ax6.axis('off')
summary_data = [
    ['Total Revenue', f"${df['total'].sum():.2f}"],
    ['Average Sale', f"${df['total'].mean():.2f}"],
    ['Total Items Sold', f"{df['quantity'].sum()}"],
    ['Unique Products', f"{df['product'].nunique()}"],
    ['Takeaway Orders', f"{df['is_takeaway'].sum()}/{len(df)}"],
    ['Peak Sale', f"${df['total'].max():.2f}"]
]
table = ax6.table(cellText=summary_data, cellLoc='left', loc='center',
                  colWidths=[0.5, 0.3], bbox=[0.1, 0.2, 0.8, 0.6])
table.auto_set_font_size(False)
table.set_fontsize(10)
table.scale(1.2, 1.5)
ax6.set_title('Summary Statistics', fontweight='bold', y=0.9)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
